_doc: Companies that do NOT file consolidated results. Their consolidated cells are NOT data gaps -- there is nothing to fill -- so coverage audits must exclude them from gap counts. Two classes: never_filed_con (no consolidated filing at any point) and stopped_filing_con (filed consolidated, then stopped -- excluded from that quarter onward). Evidence for never_filed_con: scripts/xbrl_nature.json shows >=4 cached filings and ZERO NatureOfReportStandaloneConsolidated=Consolidated declarations, AND our stored con never diverges from std. CUB and ENRIN added on the user's primary-source check (screener.in, 2026-08-06): CUB carries a single 2022-03 divergence and ENRIN too few cached filings, so the automated test could not clear them. Built 2026-08-06 after the is_con_basis fix.  started_filing_con {sym: first consolidated quarter-end}: quarters BEFORE this are not-applicable (the company had not begun filing consolidated). Positive evidence only — an exchange filing-index leading run or a documented per-quarter check; NEVER inferred from our own null cells (that inference was measured 63% wrong).
